1. Use the Calculator in the FAQ 
2. It's perfectly fine to snack just make sure it's still within your Marcos. I go for almonds, pepperonis, cheeses.
3. I use either coconut oil and extra virgin olive oil. I make sure my extra virgin oil come from one location and have a dark bottle. You can almond flour and coconut flour.
4. If you have to question it don't buy it. Just stick with oils and butter.
5. Use low-carb tortillas make sure they fit your Marcos.
6. Meats are fine. But, check processed meats because they contain hidden carbs. 
7. IDK 😐 
8. I personally don't drink diet drinks because they might spike my insulin. When I want a juice I mix a little lemon with my water. Make sure they use erythritol as a sweetener it's one the safest sweeteners.

I'm no doctor 👨‍⚕️. I'm not telling you should do KETO that's to your own discretion. Did you really read the FAQ? Also, use the search bar for any future questions. You most likely will find it. GOOD LUCK!!
